prompt: The internet is an amazing invention which has changed the world. Give the advantages and disadvantages of the internet
essay:
Society has undergone massive changes, and a big reason is technology.  The internet has changed the way people live.  It is a tremendous invention which has shaped the world.  This essay will examine both the advantages and disadvantages of the internet.

On the one hand, the internet has several advantages . First,  it is fantastic to communicate with others. Using  social media, such as WhatsApp, Snapchat, or even Instagram, is a fast way to communicate. Furthermore, many people today have email servers, sending messages with the touch of a button.  Second, the internet is helpful for business.  For example, anybody can start selling their items on a website.  Also, shopping online has become incredibly popular. Finally, the  internet is fantastic for entertainment. People spend countless hours playing video games.  As well, everyone enjoys watching movies or listening to podcasts .

On the other hand, there are some disadvantages of the internet. First, having people using technolgy to access the internet  can lead to health problems.  For example  hours of screen time can damage  the eyes. Furthermore , staying in one spot for a long period of time can lead to bone problems .This can result in arthritis.  Next, it can be a monumental waste of time.  Spending unlimited  hours in the cyber world means less time with family and friends.  Lastly, people can spread false information. For  example, hearing rumours and then spreading them online happens frequently. Also, people can create fake accounts where they include  false information.

In conclusion, it is clear to see that  the internet has brought huge advancements in communication, education, and entertainment.  However, it must be noted that along with these advantages, the internet has created many problems and does have some disadvantages.
